_comment: Who may do what through the PAM stand-in (CyberArk: Safe membership). Lab personas, not real people.
libraries: Vault library sets the person may check out from (psm-session.sh).
ssh_roles: Vault SSH CA roles the person may get a certificate from (psm-ssh.sh).
approves: Safes (library sets / SSH roles) for which this person's approval of a change counts toward
dual control (CyberArk: the Safe permission to authorise account requests). lib.sh itsm_validate counts
distinct approvers from ServiceNow's sysapproval_approver records, never the requester, only names listed
here; pam-policy.json approvals_required says how many (tier0 2, tier1 1).
Each person gets their own Guacamole user (no shared t0-operator). Lab: local password in
.secrets/operators/<name>-password. Tenant time (OIDC mode: OIDC_CLIENT_ID in .env): the key is the
Entra UPN, the user record comes from the person's first Entra sign-in, and lib.sh destroys any
local password on it and deletes the file (README, 'Per-person sign-in'). An approver who never checks
anything out (ops-dana) never gets a Guacamole user.

ops-dana.display_name: Dana - identity security lead, approver only (lab persona)
